description: Folders a local-folder source may never point at, read by the CLI (apps/cli/src/utils/local_roots.py: every scan and query) and the API (apps/api/src/utils/local-folder-path.ts: when a source is saved). containsNot: a source folder may not be or contain these (other work's temporary files). insideNot: nor lie inside, be, or contain these (the system's view of the machine; the all-in-one image's state, whose masked-config.key decrypts every workspace's source credentials, its database and its code). privateNames: no path part may start with these (a query's private and spill directories). protectedPathEnv: environment variables naming key files or folders; a source folder may not contain what they name.
